title: Learning How to Vote with Principles: Axiomatic Insights Into the Collective Decisions of Neural Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the anonymity voting axiom by randomly sampling permutations of voters in preference profiles and checking if the neural network's predicted winning set remains invariant, indicating no bias toward particular individuals.

Evaluating the neutrality voting axiom by sampling permutations of alternatives and checking if the neural network's predicted winners are correspondingly permuted, ensuring the model treats all alternatives equally.
